# Dendry scene levers — `on-arrival` / choice actions

**Status:** Jun 2026. Reference for authors editing `.scene.dry` cards and events.

Playable logic lives in `source/scenes/**/*.scene.dry`. Runtime APIs are defined in silent `*_runtime.scene.dry` scenes (compiled into `out/html/core.js`). Do not edit `source/lib/*.js` for in-game behavior.

---

## Syntax (two forms)

**Semicolon assignments** — Dendry creates missing qualities as `0` before `+=`:

```dry
on-arrival: police_reform += 1; dundalk_reform += 1
on-arrival: parochialism -= 3; parochial_radicalism -= 0.05
on-arrival: militia_auxiliary = 1
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
```

**JavaScript block** — call `Q` APIs, branching, `typeof` guards:

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.spendOrganizingAction();
if (typeof Q.bumpDistrictProsperity === 'function') {
    Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07);
}
if (typeof Q.syncIgAttitudes === 'function') { Q.syncIgAttitudes(); }
!}
```

**Conditions** use `=` not `=>`: `choose-if: police_reform > 4 and militia_auxiliary = 0`

**Party letters** in modifiers and displays: **C** corp, **G** gang, **D** dem, **H** hate, **I** ind.

---

## How levers reach the simulation

| Layer | What you set in a scene | When it bites |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------|
| **Q quality / flag** | `foo += 1` | Immediately on choice; may gate `view-if` / `choose-if` |
| **Electorate stack** | `stackId += 1` + matching row in `electorate_runtime` | Next `Q.update_projections()` (month advance, many card exits) |
| **Derived stack** | e.g. `parochialism`, `prosperity_families` | Auto-synced inside `Q.applyElectorateModifiers()` |
| **Voter-block prosperity** | `<stratum>_bump`, `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity` | `Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps()` / monthly tick |
| **IG prosperity** | `prosperity_soylent` etc. | Monthly `applyProsperityConnections()` + syndicate drone bribery sync |
| **Attitude** | `soylent_leverage += 1`, `soylent_reprisal += 2` | After change: `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` |
| **Paramilitary ledger** | `Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale`, `Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength` | Immediate; monthly tick reads `Q.districtParamilitary` |
| **Budget / assets** | `budget += 2`, `Q.queueBudgetExpense`, `Q.addAsset` | `Q.tabulateBudget()` on month tick |
| **Organizing actions** | `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` | Same month; respects `month_actions_remaining` |

Projections and polls refresh when the player advances the month (`advance` → `post_event` → `Q.monthly_tick_phase1()` → `Q.update_projections()`).

---

## Direct Q stats (semicolon-friendly)

### Calendar & phases

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `month`, `year`, `time` | Calendar (`advance` bumps month) |
| `phase` | Organizing / cable-break act gating (`city_affairs` deck: `phase > 1`) |
| `started` | New game vs menu |

### Action economy

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `organizing_unlock` | Organizing deck available |
| `month_actions_remaining` | Spend via `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` (do not decrement by hand) |
| `month_actions_limit`, `month_actions_used` | Synced by `Q.syncActionEconomyDisplay()` |
| `action_reserve` | Banks unused actions (cap 4); surge can exceed |
| `action_surge_active` | Phase-start uncapped month (set by runtime, not cards) |
| `contracting_visits_remaining` | Contracting card draws (synced from `phase`) |

### IG leverage & reprisal → attitude

Corps: `soylent_leverage`, `soylent_reprisal`, `magrail_*`, `brazos_*`  
Syndicates: `families_*`, `edges_*`, `sharks_*`

After changing leverage/reprisal, call `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` so `attitude_soylent` etc. update (see `attitude.qdisplay.dry`).

Cable negotiations use reprisal helpers (`Q.cableNegReprisalAdd` / `Sub`) — prefer those inside cable neg scenes.

### IG prosperity (0–20, clamped in economy tick)

| Quality | IG |
|---------|-----|
| `prosperity_soylent`, `prosperity_magrail`, `prosperity_brazos` | Big 3 corps |
| `prosperity_families`, `prosperity_edges`, `prosperity_sharks` | Syndicates |

Feeds home-district prosperity links, syndicate drone bribery (`Q.syncSyndicateDroneWealthStacks`), and future syndicate QNM. Display averages: `prosperity_rich`, `prosperity_drone`, … (synced from blocks, not set directly in scenes).

### City mood / xenophobia

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `parochialism` | 0–100; above 41 drives `xenophobia_derived` stack automatically |
| `parochial_radicalism` | How much xenophobia H gain Dems can claw back |
| `third_wave_on_society` | Refugee-pressure flag (e.g. Titan event) |

### Police, militia, cable payroll

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `police_reform` | Security card track; gates militia oversight |
| `police_defund`, `police_investigated` | Security card |
| `police_pay` | Poverty multiple; morale thresholds (`Q.ensurePolicePay()`) |
| `militia` | Global militia movement level (activist training) |
| `militia_police` | Volunteer patrols replacing police |
| `militia_auxiliary` | Police oversee militia (ends degrade chain) |
| `militia_degrade_timer`, `militia_degrade_ready`, `militia_degrade_district` | Countdown state (usually set by tick, not by hand) |

### Organizing tactics (monthly `organize_tick`)

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `non_violence` | Low → `protest_bad` rises faster; high → `protest_good` |
| `sabotage` | Sabotage track (reprisal interactions with cable promises) |
| `protest_good`, `protest_bad` | Accumulators; threshold effects TBD |

### Media, education, municipal AI stacks

Examples used in cards (each needs `ElectorateModifier` rows in `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`):

- `anti_corp_media`, `self_sufficiency_media`, `kiss_ass_media`
- `vocational_track`, `contract_outside`
- `ai_open_maintenance`, `ai_contract_audit`, `ai_corp_admin`
- `magic_control`, `magic_assimilate`, `magic_school`
- `coop_markets`, `coop_mother`, `coop_investment`

### Community cohesion & crime relief

From `community_outreach.scene.dry` — cohesion is narrative; `crime_relief_*` stacks are wired for future crime tick:

- `crime_relief_first_wave`, `crime_relief_second_wave`, `crime_relief_isolated`, `crime_relief_drones`, `crime_relief_otherworld`
- `first_wave_cohesion`, `second_wave_cohesion`, `isolated_cohesion`, `drones_cohesion`, `otherworld_cohesion`
- `community_*_resolved` — one-shot unlock flags

### Contract patronage flags

Set to `1` on award (`contracting.scene.dry`). Drive electorate rows and `Q.contract_patronage_count`:

`contract_big3_docks`, `contract_big3_vats`, `contract_big3_railyard`, `contract_big3_limelight`, `contract_wealthy_docks`, `contract_wealthy_aurora`, `contract_coop_aurora`, `contract_coop_pitts`, `contract_coop_deeps`, `contract_coop_docks`, `contract_outside`, `fair_contract_uses`

### Cable break / ceasefire (sample)

Many `cable_neg_*` negotiation flags; persisted promises `cable_neg_promise_*`; block flags `cable_promise_block_protest_*`, `cable_promise_block_sabotage_*`. Breaking truces: `Q.cableNegBreakPromise('protest'|'sabotage')`.

Deal outcomes: `cable_break_peace`, `civil_rights_unlock`, `corp_police_city_jurisdiction`, `corp_security_tax`, `Q.police_pay` via `Q.policePayFromCableNegLevel`.

### Drone bribery (December event)

- `drone_syndicate_bribe_boost` — stack + optional `Q.applySyndicateDroneMembershipBribe()`
- `drone_corp_bribe_slip` — stack

### Event / story flags (examples)

One-shot or persistent gates: `dundalk_reform`, `dundalk_stakeholder`, `dundalk_vigil`, `dundalk_nationalist`, `ballroom_refugee_housing`, `aurora_pyramid_housing_event`, `pitts_mines_subsidized`, `orc_marriage_*`, `jovian_refugee_prepare`, `guild_rebel_electronics_event`, advisor toggles `stacy_toggle`, `jacobs_on`, etc.

### Budget

| Quality / API | Role |
|---------------|------|
| `budget` | Simple numeric lever (e.g. MSS Dundalk `budget += 2`) |
| `Q.queueBudgetExpense(amount, sourceId, label)` | One-shot spend on next `Q.tabulateBudget()` |

### Economy display indices (mostly read by UI / future systems)

`trade_level`, `stock_soylent`, `stock_magrail`, `stock_brazos`, `cloud_9_street_price`, `edges_cyber_insurance_premium`, `ocular_index` — set in `organize_phase_tick` init or events; `trade_level` ticks monthly.

---

## Electorate modifier stacks

**Pattern:**

1. In the scene: `on-arrival: my_stack += 1`
2. In `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`: add `new ElectorateModifier('row_id', 'my_stack', scope, target, party, delta)`
3. Effect applies on next projection: **delta × stack value** to competitive scores (stratum, district, or global)

**Scopes:** `stratum` (target: `rich`, `drone`, `coop`, `first`, `second`, `third_wave`, `deeper`, `alien`), `district` (`Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`), `global` (target `''`).

**Derived stacks (do not bump in scenes unless you mean to override):**

- `xenophobia_derived`, `xenophobia_clawed_back` — from `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism`
- `drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe` — from combined syndicate `prosperity_*`
- `militia_auxiliary`, `militia`, `militia_police` — catalog rows exist for future crime hooks

Full catalog: `MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_*` in [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](../electorate_runtime.scene.dry).

---

## Prosperity levers

### Stratum bump (all blocks of one class, same month)

```dry
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
on-arrival: {! Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps() !}
```

Keys: `rich_bump`, `first_bump`, `second_bump`, `coop_bump`, `drone_bump`, `alien_bump`, `deeper_bump`, `third_wave_bump`.  
If you skip `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` in the scene, the monthly tick applies bumps at phase-1 start.

### District prosperity (all voter blocks in one district)

```dry
on-arrival: {! Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07) !}
```

District ids: `Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`.

### IG prosperity

```dry
on-arrival: prosperity_families += 1
```

Clamped 0–20 in connection tick; also bleeds to home districts per `PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

### Prosperity connection stacks

Some catalog rows use a `stackId` quality as a multiplier (same `+= 1` pattern). See `Q.prosperityConnectionCatalog` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

---

## Paramilitary / crime (partial)

**Implemented helpers** ([`crime_paramilitary_runtime.scene.dry`](../crime_paramilitary_runtime.scene.dry)):

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale('Aurora', -0.1)
Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength('Aurora', 1.25)
Q.police_pay = Q.policePayFromCableNegLevel(2)
!}
```

| API | Effect |
|-----|--------|
| `Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale(district, delta)` | District militia QNM morale (loyalty cap) |
| `Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength(district, mult)` | District punk `numbers` × mult |
| `Q.ensurePolicePay()` | Normalize invalid `Q.police_pay` to 2 |
| `Q.militiaDegradeMonthlyTick()` | Countdown (called from monthly tick, not cards) |

**Not wired from scenes yet:** writing `<district>_crime`, `Q.crime_level`, long-term crime drift, raid flags. District crime **display** is still a prosperity/poll proxy via `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` until the paramilitary tick replaces it ([`crime_paramilitary.md`](crime_paramilitary.md)).

---

## Economic assets & housing

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.addAsset({ id: 'pitts_coop_contract_workshop', name: '...', district: 'Pitts',
  ownerType: 'stratum', owner: 'coop', kind: 'workshop', major: false })
Q.addHome({ ... })
Q.queueBudgetExpense(3, 'contract_award', 'Municipal contract award')
!}
```

`Q.addAsset` / `Q.addHome` / `Q.ensureEconomicAssets` — [`economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry`](../economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry). Housing processes on `Q.processMonthlyHousing()` each month.

---

## Organizing action pattern

Most organizing subchoices:

```dry
choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0
on-arrival: {! Q.spendOrganizingAction(); my_stack += 1; !}
```

Card shell often calls `Q.syncActionEconomyDisplay()` on open.

---

## Read-only / computed (do not assign in scenes)

| Output | Source |
|--------|--------|
| `Proj_<District>_<C\|G\|D\|H\|I>`, `<District>_poll_*` | `Q.update_projections()` |
| `Docks_C`, seat counts | Election tabulation |
| `prosperity_rich`, … stratum averages | `Q.qified_block_prosperity()` |
| `<district>_prosperity`, `<district>_crime` display | `Q.syncDistrictDisplays(districtId)` — crime is **proxy** today |
| `attitude_soylent`, … | `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` from leverage/reprisal |
| `overall_tourism`, `overall_longshore` | `economy_tick()` from `trade_level` and `crime_level` |
| `xenophobia_derived` | `Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks()` |

---

## Runtime API index

| Runtime scene | Key `Q` exports for scenes |
|---------------|----------------------------|
| `organize_phase_tick` | `spendOrganizingAction`, `bumpDistrictProsperity`, `applyStratumProsperityBumps`, `syncIgAttitudes`, `syncActionEconomyDisplay`, `syncContractingAllowance` |
| `electorate_runtime` | (stacks only via qualities); `applyElectorateModifiers` is internal to projections |
| `election_runtime` | `update_projections`, `syncDistrictDisplays`, `runScheduledElections` |
| `attitude_runtime` | `syncIgAttitudes`, `attitude` |
| `economic_assets_runtime` | `addAsset`, `addHome`, `queueBudgetExpense`, `updateJacobsAssetsReport` |
| `crime_paramilitary_runtime` | `bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale`, `bumpDistrictPunkStrength`, `policePayFromCableNegLevel`, `ensurePolicePay` |
| `cable_break_negotiations` | `cableNegBreakPromise`, reprisal helpers (large local API) |

Bootstrap order: [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](../setup_functions.scene.dry) loads missing runtimes before `main`.

---

## Checklist for a new choice effect

1. Pick lever type: flag, stack, prosperity, leverage, or `Q` API.
2. If stack: add `ElectorateModifier` row(s) before relying on `foo += 1`.
3. If attitude-sensitive: end with `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`.
4. If prosperity same month: call `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` or `bumpDistrictProsperity` in the same `on-arrival`.
5. If spend is an organizing action: `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` + `choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0`.
6. Run `npm run lint:dendry` and `npm run make-html` before shipping.

7. **Assets/budget** — `addAsset`, `queueBudgetExpense`

9. **Runtime API index** and a short checklist for new choices

The problem is particularly severe among the non-human populations from the otherworld.

## Electorate modifier stacks

**Pattern:**

1. In the scene: `on-arrival: my_stack += 1`
2. In `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`: add `new ElectorateModifier('row_id', 'my_stack', scope, target, party, delta)`
3. Effect applies on next projection: **delta × stack value** to competitive scores (stratum, district, or global)

**Scopes:** `stratum` (target: `rich`, `drone`, `coop`, `first`, `second`, `third_wave`, `deeper`, `alien`), `district` (`Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`), `global` (target `''`).

**Derived stacks (do not bump in scenes unless you mean to override):**

- `xenophobia_derived`, `xenophobia_clawed_back` — from `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism`
- `drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe` — from combined syndicate `prosperity_*`
- `militia_auxiliary`, `militia`, `militia_police` — catalog rows exist for future crime hooks

Full catalog: `MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_*` in [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](../electorate_runtime.scene.dry).

## Checklist for a new choice effect

1. Pick lever type: flag, stack, prosperity, leverage, or `Q` API.
2. If stack: add `ElectorateModifier` row(s) before relying on `foo += 1`.
3. If attitude-sensitive: end with `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`.
4. If prosperity same month: call `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` or `bumpDistrictProsperity` in the same `on-arrival`.
5. If spend is an organizing action: `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` + `choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0`.
6. Run `npm run lint:dendry` and `npm run make-html` before shipping.

## Plan: playable path to refugee crisis **start** (Feb 2302)

Goal: a new player can advance from **January 2300 → January 2302**, hit the major story beats, and see **`refugees_titan`** fire as the crisis opener without dead ends or silent broken systems.

### Phase A — Core loop hygiene (blocking)

1. ~~**Advance `phase` beyond 1**~~ — **Done:** [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2` when ≥2 megacorps accept the ceasefire (Jun 2301). Optionally tie [`organize_phase_tick`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) trade-level `phase` bands to calendar elsewhere.
2. ~~**Remove SPD leftovers**~~ — **Done:** deleted [`shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry). **Next:** design a `#city_affairs` card to renegotiate corp control of civil rights, judiciary, and related government levers (see table above).
3. **Fix [`organize_phase_start`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) entry** — Either gate it to Jan 2300 month 1 (first `post_event`) or chain explicitly from [`root`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` so `organizing_unlock` is guaranteed before October events.
4. **Date-gate [`drone_vote_buying`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry)** — Add `year`, `max-visits`, or remove until designed; avoid firing every December forever.

### Phase B — 2300–2301 story spine (content)

5. ~~**September Convention fallout**~~ — **Done:** [`september_convention`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) permit bumps `parochialism`; ban cuts `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism` and stacks `first_wave_ban_slights` (first-stratum poll modifiers in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry)).
6. ~~**Migrations card window**~~ — **Done:** [`migrations`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) now **`year >= 2302`** (was Jan–May 2300); problem/opportunity subscenes still need stack wiring if desired.
7. **Cable arc polish** — Close negotiation TODOs (tax → budget, disband flags); smoke-test syndicate timed events from a Jun 2301 deal through +1 / +3 months.
8. ~~**Dundalk + orc events**~~ — **Done (orc):** [`orc_marriage2`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry) sets `orc_marriage_*` stacks; stratum poll shifts in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry). Dundalk stacks already wired; verify martyrs in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry) if needed.

### Phase C — Bridge to 2302 (refugee runway)

9. **Implement [`mikasa_journey_inbound`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry)** — Short narrative + any flags needed before Titan (or remove hijack from [`post_event`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) if unnecessary). Today it fires **before** Feb crisis and does nothing visible.
10. **Refugee prelude qualities** — Optionally add 2301 foreshadowing (library / peer media / status) referencing Jovian clan wars and kipple so Feb–Apr events aren't the first mention.
11. **Election coverage Jan 2300–Jan 2302** — Confirm [`runScheduledElections`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) fires for all district months on calendar; player sees [`scheduled_elections`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) at least twice before 2302.

### Phase D — Refugee crisis **start** (milestone deliverable)

12. **Verify Feb 2302 trigger** — [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry): `jovian_refugee_prepare` / `jovian_refugee_dread` stacks already wired in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry); playtest that `third_wave_on_society = 1` unlocks third-wave prosperity row in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry).
13. **Minimal follow-through for Mar–Apr** — Expand [`refugees_earth`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) and [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) with at least one meaningful stack or budget/housing pressure each (crisis **continues**, but start is Feb Titan).
14. **Smoke test full timeline** — Dev cheat or `npm run`-style month advance: 2300-01 → 2302-02 in one session; no JS errors; main deck always has Advance; organizing cards appear after unlock.

### Phase E — Nice-to-have before playtesting wider (non-blocking for “crisis start”)

- **Implement district crime / paramilitary tick** — [`crime_paramilitary.md`](source/scenes/planning/crime_paramilitary.md) (QNM ledger, `R` threshold bands, modifier stacks).
- Wire [`corp_conflict`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) into monthly tick while `cable_break_peace = 0`.
- Enable `#advisor` deck with Mikasa conditions.
- Hook [`industries/mining`](source/scenes/industries/mining.scene.dry) into organizing or city deck.
- Third-wave voter blocks in [`election_runtime`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) if elections should shift after `third_wave_on_society`.

## Plan: playable path to refugee crisis **start** (Feb 2302)

Goal: a new player can advance from **January 2300 → January 2302**, hit the major story beats, and see **`refugees_titan`** fire as the crisis opener without dead ends or silent broken systems.

### Phase A — Core loop hygiene (blocking)

1. ~~**Advance `phase` beyond 1**~~ — **Done:** [`cable_break_negotiations`](source/scenes/major/cable_break_negotiations.scene.dry) sets `phase = 2` when ≥2 megacorps accept the ceasefire (Jun 2301). Optionally tie [`organize_phase_tick`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_tick.scene.dry) trade-level `phase` bands to calendar elsewhere.
2. ~~**Remove SPD leftovers**~~ — **Done:** deleted [`shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry`](source/scenes/cards/city_affairs/shuffle_cabinet.scene.dry). **Next:** design a `#city_affairs` card to renegotiate corp control of civil rights, judiciary, and related government levers (see table above).
3. **Fix [`organize_phase_start`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry) entry** — Either gate it to Jan 2300 month 1 (first `post_event`) or chain explicitly from [`root`](source/scenes/root.scene.dry) `@2300_main_continue` so `organizing_unlock` is guaranteed before October events.
4. **Date-gate [`drone_vote_buying`](source/scenes/background/drone_vote_buying.dry)** — Add `year`, `max-visits`, or remove until designed; avoid firing every December forever.

### Phase B — 2300–2301 story spine (content)

5. ~~**September Convention fallout**~~ — **Done:** [`september_convention`](source/scenes/events/september_convention.scene.dry) permit bumps `parochialism`; ban cuts `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism` and stacks `first_wave_ban_slights` (first-stratum poll modifiers in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry)).
6. ~~**Migrations card window**~~ — **Done:** [`migrations`](source/scenes/cards/local_organizing/migrations.scene.dry) now **`year >= 2302`** (was Jan–May 2300); problem/opportunity subscenes still need stack wiring if desired.
7. **Cable arc polish** — Close negotiation TODOs (tax → budget, disband flags); smoke-test syndicate timed events from a Jun 2301 deal through +1 / +3 months.
8. ~~**Dundalk + orc events**~~ — **Done (orc):** [`orc_marriage2`](source/scenes/events/orc_marriage2.scene.dry) sets `orc_marriage_*` stacks; stratum poll shifts in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry). Dundalk stacks already wired; verify martyrs in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry) if needed.

### Phase C — Bridge to 2302 (refugee runway)

9. **Implement [`mikasa_journey_inbound`](source/scenes/background/mikasa_journey_inbound.scene.dry)** — Short narrative + any flags needed before Titan (or remove hijack from [`post_event`](source/scenes/post_event.scene.dry) if unnecessary). Today it fires **before** Feb crisis and does nothing visible.
10. **Refugee prelude qualities** — Optionally add 2301 foreshadowing (library / peer media / status) referencing Jovian clan wars and kipple so Feb–Apr events aren't the first mention.
11. **Election coverage Jan 2300–Jan 2302** — Confirm [`runScheduledElections`](source/scenes/election_runtime.scene.dry) fires for all district months on calendar; player sees [`scheduled_elections`](source/scenes/events/scheduled_elections.scene.dry) at least twice before 2302.

### Phase D — Refugee crisis **start** (milestone deliverable)

12. **Verify Feb 2302 trigger** — [`refugees_titan`](source/scenes/major/refugees_titan.scene.dry): `jovian_refugee_prepare` / `jovian_refugee_dread` stacks already wired in [`electorate_runtime`](source/scenes/electorate_runtime.scene.dry); playtest that `third_wave_on_society = 1` unlocks third-wave prosperity row in [`status`](source/scenes/status.scene.dry).
13. **Minimal follow-through for Mar–Apr** — Expand [`refugees_earth`](source/scenes/major/refugees_earth.scene.dry) and [`refugees_otherworld`](source/scenes/major/refugees_otherworld.scene.dry) with at least one meaningful stack or budget/housing pressure each (crisis **continues**, but start is Feb Titan).
14. **Smoke test full timeline** — Dev cheat or `npm run`-style month advance: 2300-01 → 2302-02 in one session; no JS errors; main deck always has Advance; organizing cards appear after unlock.

### Phase E — Nice-to-have before playtesting wider (non-blocking for “crisis start”)

- **Implement district crime / paramilitary tick** — [`crime_paramilitary.md`](source/scenes/planning/crime_paramilitary.md) (QNM ledger, `R` threshold bands, modifier stacks).
- Wire [`corp_conflict`](source/scenes/background/corp_conflict.scene.dry) into monthly tick while `cable_break_peace = 0`.
- Enable `#advisor` deck with Mikasa conditions.

# Dendry scene levers — `on-arrival` / choice actions

**Status:** Jun 2026. Reference for authors editing `.scene.dry` cards and events.

Playable logic lives in `source/scenes/**/*.scene.dry`. Runtime APIs are defined in silent `*_runtime.scene.dry` scenes (compiled into `out/html/core.js`). Do not edit `source/lib/*.js` for in-game behavior.

---

## Syntax (two forms)

**Semicolon assignments** — Dendry creates missing qualities as `0` before `+=`:

```dry
on-arrival: police_reform += 1; dundalk_reform += 1
on-arrival: parochialism -= 3; parochial_radicalism -= 0.05
on-arrival: militia_auxiliary = 1
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
```

**JavaScript block** — call `Q` APIs, branching, `typeof` guards:

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.spendOrganizingAction();
if (typeof Q.bumpDistrictProsperity === 'function') {
    Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07);
}
if (typeof Q.syncIgAttitudes === 'function') { Q.syncIgAttitudes(); }
!}
```

**Conditions** use `=` not `=>`: `choose-if: police_reform > 4 and militia_auxiliary = 0`

**Party letters** in modifiers and displays: **C** corp, **G** gang, **D** dem, **H** hate, **I** ind.

---

## How levers reach the simulation

| Layer | What you set in a scene | When it bites |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------|
| **Q quality / flag** | `foo += 1` | Immediately on choice; may gate `view-if` / `choose-if` |
| **Electorate stack** | `stackId += 1` + matching row in `electorate_runtime` | Next `Q.update_projections()` (month advance, many card exits) |
| **Derived stack** | e.g. `parochialism`, `prosperity_families` | Auto-synced inside `Q.applyElectorateModifiers()` |
| **Voter-block prosperity** | `<stratum>_bump`, `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity` | `Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps()` / monthly tick |
| **IG prosperity** | `prosperity_soylent` etc. | Monthly `applyProsperityConnections()` + syndicate drone bribery sync |
| **Attitude** | `soylent_leverage += 1`, `soylent_reprisal += 2` | After change: `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` |
| **Paramilitary ledger** | `Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale`, `Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength` | Immediate; monthly tick reads `Q.districtParamilitary` |
| **Budget / assets** | `budget += 2`, `Q.queueBudgetExpense`, `Q.addAsset` | `Q.tabulateBudget()` on month tick |
| **Organizing actions** | `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` | Same month; respects `month_actions_remaining` |

Projections and polls refresh when the player advances the month (`advance` → `post_event` → `Q.monthly_tick_phase1()` → `Q.update_projections()`).

---

### Calendar & phases

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `month`, `year`, `time` | Calendar (`advance` bumps month) |
| `phase` | Act gate: `>= 1` organizing cards; `> 1` City Affairs ([`main.scene.dry`](../main.scene.dry)). Set to `1` in [`organize_phase_start`](../cards/local_organizing/organize_phase_start.scene.dry); `2` on cable ceasefire deal. |
| `started` | New game vs menu |

### Action economy

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `month_actions_remaining` | Spend via `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` (do not decrement by hand) |
| `month_actions_limit`, `month_actions_used` | Synced by `Q.syncActionEconomyDisplay()` |
| `action_reserve` | Banks unused actions (cap 4); surge can exceed |
| `action_surge_active` | Phase-start uncapped month (set by runtime, not cards) |
| `contracting_visits_remaining` | Contracting card draws (synced from `phase`) |

Corps: `soylent_leverage`, `soylent_reprisal`, `magrail_*`, `brazos_*`

### Economy display indices (mostly read by UI / future systems)

`trade_level`, `stock_soylent`, `stock_magrail`, `stock_brazos`, `cloud_9_street_price`, `edges_cyber_insurance_premium`, `ocular_index` — set in `organize_phase_tick` init or events; `trade_level` ticks monthly.

---

## Electorate modifier stacks

**Pattern:**

1. In the scene: `on-arrival: my_stack += 1`
2. In `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`: add `new ElectorateModifier('row_id', 'my_stack', scope, target, party, delta)`
3. Effect applies on next projection: **delta × stack value** to competitive scores (stratum, district, or global)

**Scopes:** `stratum` (target: `rich`, `drone`, `coop`, `first`, `second`, `third_wave`, `deeper`, `alien`), `district` (`Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`), `global` (target `''`).

**Derived stacks (do not bump in scenes unless you mean to override):**

- `xenophobia_derived`, `xenophobia_clawed_back` — from `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism`
- `drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe` — from combined syndicate `prosperity_*`
- `militia_auxiliary`, `militia`, `militia_police` — catalog rows exist for future crime hooks

Full catalog: `MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_*` in [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](../electorate_runtime.scene.dry).

---

## Prosperity levers

### Stratum bump (all blocks of one class, same month)

```dry
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
on-arrival: {! Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps() !}
```

Keys: `rich_bump`, `first_bump`, `second_bump`, `coop_bump`, `drone_bump`, `alien_bump`, `deeper_bump`, `third_wave_bump`.  
If you skip `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` in the scene, the monthly tick applies bumps at phase-1 start.

### District prosperity (all voter blocks in one district)

```dry
on-arrival: {! Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07) !}
```

District ids: `Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`.

### IG prosperity

```dry
on-arrival: prosperity_families += 1
```

Clamped 0–20 in connection tick; also bleeds to home districts per `PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

### Prosperity connection stacks

Some catalog rows use a `stackId` quality as a multiplier (same `+= 1` pattern). See `Q.prosperityConnectionCatalog` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

---

## Paramilitary / crime (partial)

**Implemented helpers** ([`crime_paramilitary_runtime.scene.dry`](../crime_paramilitary_runtime.scene.dry)):

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale('Aurora', -0.1)
Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength('Aurora', 1.25)
Q.police_pay = Q.policePayFromCableNegLevel(2)
!}
```

| API | Effect |
|-----|--------|
| `Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale(district, delta)` | District militia QNM morale (loyalty cap) |
| `Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength(district, mult)` | District punk `numbers` × mult |
| `Q.ensurePolicePay()` | Normalize invalid `Q.police_pay` to 2 |
| `Q.militiaDegradeMonthlyTick()` | Countdown (called from monthly tick, not cards) |

**Not wired from scenes yet:** writing `<district>_crime`, `Q.crime_level`, long-term crime drift, raid flags. District crime **display** is still a prosperity/poll proxy via `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` until the paramilitary tick replaces it ([`crime_paramilitary.md`](crime_paramilitary.md)).

---

## Economic assets & housing

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.addAsset({ id: 'pitts_coop_contract_workshop', name: '...', district: 'Pitts',
  ownerType: 'stratum', owner: 'coop', kind: 'workshop', major: false })
Q.addHome({ ... })
Q.queueBudgetExpense(3, 'contract_award', 'Municipal contract award')
!}
```

`Q.addAsset` / `Q.addHome` / `Q.ensureEconomicAssets` — [`economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry`](../economic_assets_runtime.scene.dry). Housing processes on `Q.processMonthlyHousing()` each month.

---

## Organizing action pattern

Most organizing subchoices:

```dry
choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0
on-arrival: {! Q.spendOrganizingAction(); my_stack += 1; !}
```

Card shell often calls `Q.syncActionEconomyDisplay()` on open.

---

## Read-only / computed (do not assign in scenes)

| Output | Source |
|--------|--------|
| `Proj_<District>_<C\|G\|D\|H\|I>`, `<District>_poll_*` | `Q.update_projections()` |
| `Docks_C`, seat counts | Election tabulation |
| `prosperity_rich`, … stratum averages | `Q.qified_block_prosperity()` |
| `<district>_prosperity`, `<district>_crime` display | `Q.syncDistrictDisplays(districtId)` — crime is **proxy** today |
| `attitude_soylent`, … | `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` from leverage/reprisal |
| `overall_tourism`, `overall_longshore` | `economy_tick()` from `trade_level` and `crime_level` |
| `xenophobia_derived` | `Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks()` |

---

## Runtime API index

| Runtime scene | Key `Q` exports for scenes |
|---------------|----------------------------|
| `organize_phase_tick` | `spendOrganizingAction`, `bumpDistrictProsperity`, `applyStratumProsperityBumps`, `syncIgAttitudes`, `syncActionEconomyDisplay`, `syncContractingAllowance` |
| `electorate_runtime` | (stacks only via qualities); `applyElectorateModifiers` is internal to projections |
| `election_runtime` | `update_projections`, `syncDistrictDisplays`, `runScheduledElections` |
| `attitude_runtime` | `syncIgAttitudes`, `attitude` |
| `economic_assets_runtime` | `addAsset`, `addHome`, `queueBudgetExpense`, `updateJacobsAssetsReport` |
| `crime_paramilitary_runtime` | `bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale`, `bumpDistrictPunkStrength`, `policePayFromCableNegLevel`, `ensurePolicePay` |
| `cable_break_negotiations` | `cableNegBreakPromise`, reprisal helpers (large local API) |

Bootstrap order: [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](../setup_functions.scene.dry) loads missing runtimes before `main`.

---

## Checklist for a new choice effect

1. Pick lever type: flag, stack, prosperity, leverage, or `Q` API.
2. If stack: add `ElectorateModifier` row(s) before relying on `foo += 1`.
3. If attitude-sensitive: end with `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`.
4. If prosperity same month: call `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` or `bumpDistrictProsperity` in the same `on-arrival`.
5. If spend is an organizing action: `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` + `choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0`.
6. Run `npm run lint:dendry` and `npm run make-html` before shipping.

Removed `organizing_unlock` everywhere. Organizing is gated on **`phase >= 1`** instead:

| Location | Change |
|----------|--------|
| `organize_phase_start.scene.dry` | Only sets `phase = 1` (dropped `organizing_unlock`) |

Same behavior: `phase = 1` at prologue start, `phase = 2` after cable ceasefire unlocks City Affairs (`phase > 1`). Lint and build pass.
make the stacy primogen advisor card give information about the paramilitary strengths in the various districts, like how jacobs gives information about assets

Planning to add paramilitary report functions in `crime_paramilitary_runtime` before the `ensurePolicePay()` export section. This follows the same pattern as Jacobs' asset reporting.

The plan covers five functions: collecting district paramilitary rows, compact QNM formatting, report text and HTML generation, rendering with a `.stacy-paramilitary-report` class, and updating the display. Each district row will list police, militia, and punk strengths, flag when militia exceeds police outside Pittsburg, and note outlaw activity.

Footer will include police pay and global militia level. Strengths round to three decimals. A fallback scene loads the runtime if the function is missing. The API exports `updateStacyParamilitaryReport` and `renderStacyParamilitaryReport`. The Stacy scene needs a `@stacy_paramilitary_survey` subscene.

A `formatStrength` helper will round values to three decimals. The HTML table will list District, Police, Militia, Punks, and Notes columns. Notes will flag militia leads and degrade fuses. QNM breakdowns will stay out of the main table to keep it simple like Jacobs. The collect function will be named `collectDistrictParamilitaryReportRows`.

The collection loop iterates over `MIKASA_PARAMILITARY_DISTRICTS`, fetching police, militia, and punk strengths per district. It flags militia leads only for districts listed in `MILITIA_DEGRADE_DISTRICTS` and checks the active degrade timer.

| `militia_police` | Volunteer patrols replacing police |
| `militia_auxiliary` | Police oversee militia (ends degrade chain) |
| `militia_degrade_timer`, `militia_degrade_ready`, `militia_degrade_district` | Countdown state (usually set by tick, not by hand) |

### Organizing tactics (monthly `organize_tick`)

| Quality | Role |
|---------|------|
| `non_violence` | Low → `protest_bad` rises faster; high → `protest_good` |
| `sabotage` | Sabotage track (reprisal interactions with cable promises) |
| `protest_good`, `protest_bad` | Accumulators; threshold effects TBD |

Examples used in cards (each needs `ElectorateModifier` rows in `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`):

- `vocational_track`, `contract_outside`
- `ai_open_maintenance`, `ai_contract_audit`, `ai_corp_admin`
- `magic_control`, `magic_assimilate`, `magic_school`
- `coop_markets`, `coop_mother`, `coop_investment`

### Community cohesion & crime relief

From `community_outreach.scene.dry` — cohesion is narrative; `crime_relief_*` stacks are wired for future crime tick:

- `crime_relief_first_wave`, `crime_relief_second_wave`, `crime_relief_isolated`, `crime_relief_drones`, `crime_relief_otherworld`
- `first_wave_cohesion`, `second_wave_cohesion`, `isolated_cohesion`, `drones_cohesion`, `otherworld_cohesion`
- `community_*_resolved` — one-shot unlock flags

Set to `1` on award (`contracting.scene.dry`). Drive electorate rows and `Q.contract_patronage_count`:


1. Pick lever type: flag, stack, prosperity, leverage, or `Q` API.

Stacy now has a **Street strength by district** survey, matching Jacobs’ asset survey pattern.

### Stacy card (`stacy.scene.dry`)
- New choice: **Street strength by district**
- Boots `crime_paramilitary_runtime` if needed (same pattern as Jacobs → `economic_assets_runtime`)
- Renders into `.stacy-paramilitary-report` on `on-display`
- Linked from the toggle on/off substates too

### Report (`crime_paramilitary_runtime`)
Per district table:
| Column | Content |
|--------|---------|
| **Police / Militia / Punks** | QNM strength (Q×N×M) |
| **Notes** | `militia>police` where that triggers the degrade fuse (non-Pitts); `fuse Nmo` if a countdown is active |

Footer: police pay, global militia level, patrol districts, and a note that syndicate muscle isn’t in the ledger yet (punks only on the outlaw side).

Exported APIs: `Q.updateStacyParamilitaryReport`, `Q.renderStacyParamilitaryReport`, plus text/HTML formatters. Plain text is stored on `Q.stacy_paramilitary_report` for special scenes or debugging.
is there a prosperity bump option that restricts on both class and district?  So lower the prosperity of first wave in the docks by 0.05 for example.

The block ID for Docks first wave is `Docks_first`. Now weighing options for restricting the prosperity bump to both class and district.

No dedicated one-shot option exists. `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity` applies citywide to all strata within a district. A JavaScript workaround would require looping blocks by district and demographic, but `clampProsperity` is likely internal and not exported.

ProsperityConnectionModifier could target a district-to-stratum scope, though it may only apply within the district. Block-scoped modifiers are monthly recurring, not one-shot. Economic assets might offer stratum-and-district-specific penalties instead.

**Not as a one-shot scene lever.** The existing bump helpers are either citywide-by-class or whole-district, not both.

### What exists today

| Mechanism | Scope | Example |
|-----------|--------|---------|
| `<stratum>_bump` + `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` | **Class, all districts** | `first_bump = -0.05` → every **first** block citywide |
| `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity(district, amount)` | **District, all classes** | `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Docks', -0.05)` → every stratum in the Docks |

There is no `docks_first_bump` quality or `Q.bumpStratumProsperityInDistrict('Docks', 'first', -0.05)`.

### Related (ongoing, not one-shot)

- **Intra-district mesh** — stratum-to-stratum spillover *within* a district (monthly, coefficient-based).
- **IG home-district links** — e.g. Brazos → **first** blocks in **Limelight** only (structural, not a card bump).
- **Pitts crime link** — `crime_level` hits specific strata in **Pitts** only (monthly, via `PROSPERITY_PITTS_CRIME`).

`ProsperityConnectionModifier` supports `block` scope (`toTarget: 'Docks_first'`) but that’s for recurring connection rows, not the same as Jacobs-style one-shot bumps.

### If you need it in a scene now

The voter block id is `District_stratum` (e.g. `Docks_first`). You’d need a JS block that finds that block in `Q.electionV2.blocks` and adjusts `block.prosperity`, then calls `Q.qified_block_prosperity()` — `clampProsperity` isn’t exported on `Q`.

### Clean addition (if you want it)

A small helper in `organize_phase_tick` would fit the existing pattern:

```javascript
Q.bumpBlockProsperity('Docks', 'first', -0.05)
// or one-shot: docks_first_bump = -0.05 in applyStratumProsperityBumps-style pass
```

Say if you want that implemented; it’s a small addition to `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.
yeah, could you put in the helper to enable `Q.bumpBlockProsperity('Docks', 'first', -0.05)`?
Adding `bumpBlockProsperity` to the helper module. It will be exported on `Q`, registered in `ORGANIZE_API`, and documented in `dendry-scene-levers.md`.

# Dendry scene levers — `on-arrival` / choice actions

**Status:** Jun 2026. Reference for authors editing `.scene.dry` cards and events.

Playable logic lives in `source/scenes/**/*.scene.dry`. Runtime APIs are defined in silent `*_runtime.scene.dry` scenes (compiled into `out/html/core.js`). Do not edit `source/lib/*.js` for in-game behavior.

---

## Syntax (two forms)

**Semicolon assignments** — Dendry creates missing qualities as `0` before `+=`:

```dry
on-arrival: police_reform += 1; dundalk_reform += 1
on-arrival: parochialism -= 3; parochial_radicalism -= 0.05
on-arrival: militia_auxiliary = 1
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
```

**JavaScript block** — call `Q` APIs, branching, `typeof` guards:

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.spendOrganizingAction();
if (typeof Q.bumpDistrictProsperity === 'function') {
    Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07);
}
if (typeof Q.syncIgAttitudes === 'function') { Q.syncIgAttitudes(); }
!}
```

**Conditions** use `=` not `=>`: `choose-if: police_reform > 4 and militia_auxiliary = 0`

**Party letters** in modifiers and displays: **C** corp, **G** gang, **D** dem, **H** hate, **I** ind.

---

## How levers reach the simulation

| Layer | What you set in a scene | When it bites |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------|
| **Q quality / flag** | `foo += 1` | Immediately on choice; may gate `view-if` / `choose-if` |
| **Electorate stack** | `stackId += 1` + matching row in `electorate_runtime` | Next `Q.update_projections()` (month advance, many card exits) |
| **Derived stack** | e.g. `parochialism`, `prosperity_families` | Auto-synced inside `Q.applyElectorateModifiers()` |

| **Organizing actions** | `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` | Same month; respects `month_actions_remaining` |

**Status:** Jun 2026. Reference for authors editing `.scene.dry` cards and events.

## Syntax (two forms)

**Semicolon assignments** — Dendry creates missing qualities as `0` before `+=`:

```dry
on-arrival: police_reform += 1; dundalk_reform += 1
on-arrival: parochialism -= 3; parochial_radicalism -= 0.05
on-arrival: militia_auxiliary = 1
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
```

**JavaScript block** — call `Q` APIs, branching, `typeof` guards:

```dry
on-arrival: {!
Q.spendOrganizingAction();
if (typeof Q.bumpDistrictProsperity === 'function') {
    Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07);
}
if (typeof Q.syncIgAttitudes === 'function') { Q.syncIgAttitudes(); }
!}
```

**Conditions** use `=` not `=>`: `choose-if: police_reform > 4 and militia_auxiliary = 0`

**Party letters** in modifiers and displays: **C** corp, **G** gang, **D** dem, **H** hate, **I** ind.

## How levers reach the simulation

| Layer | What you set in a scene | When it bites |
|-------|-------------------------|---------------|
| **Q quality / flag** | `foo += 1` | Immediately on choice; may gate `view-if` / `choose-if` |
| **Electorate stack** | `stackId += 1` + matching row in `electorate_runtime` | Next `Q.update_projections()` (month advance, many card exits) |
| **Derived stack** | e.g. `parochialism`, `prosperity_families` | Auto-synced inside `Q.applyElectorateModifiers()` |
| **Voter-block prosperity** | `<stratum>_bump`, `Q.bumpDistrictProsperity`, `Q.bumpBlockProsperity` | `Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps()` / monthly tick |
| **IG prosperity** | `prosperity_soylent` etc. | Monthly `applyProsperityConnections()` + syndicate drone bribery sync |
| **Attitude** | `soylent_leverage += 1`, `soylent_reprisal += 2` | After change: `Q.syncIgAttitudes()` |
| **Paramilitary ledger** | `Q.bumpDistrictMilitiaMorale`, `Q.bumpDistrictPunkStrength` | Immediate; monthly tick reads `Q.districtParamilitary` |

## Electorate modifier stacks

**Pattern:**

1. In the scene: `on-arrival: my_stack += 1`
2. In `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`: add `new ElectorateModifier('row_id', 'my_stack', scope, target, party, delta)`
3. Effect applies on next projection: **delta × stack value** to competitive scores (stratum, district, or global)

**Scopes:** `stratum` (target: `rich`, `drone`, `coop`, `first`, `second`, `third_wave`, `deeper`, `alien`), `district` (`Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`), `global` (target `''`).

- `xenophobia_derived`, `xenophobia_clawed_back` — from `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism`
- `drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe` — from combined syndicate `prosperity_*`
- `militia_auxiliary`, `militia`, `militia_police` — catalog rows exist for future crime hooks

Full catalog: `MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_*` in [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](../electorate_runtime.scene.dry).

## Electorate modifier stacks

**Pattern:**

1. In the scene: `on-arrival: my_stack += 1`
2. In `electorate_runtime.scene.dry`: add `new ElectorateModifier('row_id', 'my_stack', scope, target, party, delta)`
3. Effect applies on next projection: **delta × stack value** to competitive scores (stratum, district, or global)

**Scopes:** `stratum` (target: `rich`, `drone`, `coop`, `first`, `second`, `third_wave`, `deeper`, `alien`), `district` (`Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`), `global` (target `''`).

**Derived stacks (do not bump in scenes unless you mean to override):**

- `xenophobia_derived`, `xenophobia_clawed_back` — from `parochialism` / `parochial_radicalism`
- `drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe` — from combined syndicate `prosperity_*`
- `militia_auxiliary`, `militia`, `militia_police` — catalog rows exist for future crime hooks

Full catalog: `MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_*` in [`electorate_runtime.scene.dry`](../electorate_runtime.scene.dry).

---

## Prosperity levers

### Stratum bump (all blocks of one class, same month)

```dry
on-arrival: coop_bump = 0.05
on-arrival: {! Q.applyStratumProsperityBumps() !}
```

Keys: `rich_bump`, `first_bump`, `second_bump`, `coop_bump`, `drone_bump`, `alien_bump`, `deeper_bump`, `third_wave_bump`.  
If you skip `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` in the scene, the monthly tick applies bumps at phase-1 start.

### District prosperity (all strata in one district)

```dry
on-arrival: {! Q.bumpDistrictProsperity('Pitts', 0.07) !}
```

District ids: `Docks`, `Aurora`, `Vats`, `Railyard`, `Pitts`, `Limelight`, `Deeps`.

### Block prosperity (one district × stratum)

```dry
on-arrival: {! Q.bumpBlockProsperity('Docks', 'first', -0.05) !}
```

Stratum ids: `rich`, `first`, `second`, `coop`, `drone`, `alien`, `deeper`, `third_wave`. Block id at runtime is `<District>_<stratum>` (e.g. `Docks_first`).

### IG prosperity

```dry
on-arrival: prosperity_families += 1
```

Clamped 0–20 in connection tick; also bleeds to home districts per `PROSPERITY_IG_HOME_DISTRICT_LINKS` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

### Prosperity connection stacks

Some catalog rows use a `stackId` quality as a multiplier (same `+= 1` pattern). See `Q.prosperityConnectionCatalog` in `organize_phase_tick.scene.dry`.

| `Q.ensurePolicePay()` | Normalize invalid `Q.police_pay` to 2 |
| `Q.militiaDegradeMonthlyTick()` | Countdown (called from monthly tick, not cards) |

**Not wired from scenes yet:** writing `<district>_crime`, `Q.crime_level`, long-term crime drift, raid flags. District crime **display** is still a prosperity/poll proxy via `Q.syncDistrictDisplays()` until the paramilitary tick replaces it ([`crime_paramilitary.md`](crime_paramilitary.md)).

| Runtime scene | Key `Q` exports for scenes |
|---------------|----------------------------|
| `organize_phase_tick` | `spendOrganizingAction`, `bumpDistrictProsperity`, `bumpBlockProsperity`, `applyStratumProsperityBumps`, `syncIgAttitudes`, `syncActionEconomyDisplay`, `syncContractingAllowance` |

Bootstrap order: [`setup_functions.scene.dry`](../setup_functions.scene.dry) loads missing runtimes before `main`.

---

## Checklist for a new choice effect

1. Pick lever type: flag, stack, prosperity, leverage, or `Q` API.
2. If stack: add `ElectorateModifier` row(s) before relying on `foo += 1`.
3. If attitude-sensitive: end with `Q.syncIgAttitudes()`.
4. If prosperity same month: call `applyStratumProsperityBumps()` or `bumpDistrictProsperity` in the same `on-arrival`.
5. If spend is an organizing action: `Q.spendOrganizingAction()` + `choose-if: month_actions_remaining > 0`.
6. Run `npm run lint:dendry` and `npm run make-html` before shipping.

// MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_BEGIN
// --- Electorate modifiers (applied after vote-label sync in Q.update_projections) ---
// stackId: Q quality bumped in events (e.g. favor_second_wave_housing_dispute += 1).
// Several rows may share one stackId (multiple effects per choice).
// Dendry initializes missing qualities to 0 before +=. Each poll applies delta * stacks.
// Scopes: stratum (demographic), district (region), global.

var ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS = ['D', 'I', 'C', 'G', 'H']

function electorateZeroScores() {
    return { D: 0, I: 0, C: 0, G: 0, H: 0 }
}

function electorateCopyScores(src) {
    var out = electorateZeroScores()
    for (var i = 0; i < ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS.length; i++) {
        var k = ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS[i]
        out[k] = (src && src[k]) || 0
    }
    return out
}

function electorateAddDelta(scores, party, delta) {
    if (scores && scores[party] !== undefined) {
        scores[party] += delta
    }
}

var ELECTORATE_SCOPES = { stratum: 1, district: 1, global: 1 }

class ElectorateModifier {
    /**
     * Positional (table-friendly):
     *   new ElectorateModifier(rowId, stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])
     *   new ElectorateModifier(stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])  // legacy: rowId = stackId
     * stackId: Q quality for stacks (favor_second_wave_housing_dispute += 1).
     * scope: 'stratum' | 'district' | 'global' — use '' for target when global.
     * Object form: { id, stackId?, scope, target, party, delta, activeIf? }
     */
    constructor(rowId, stackId, scope, target, party, delta, activeIf) {
        var fromObject = rowId && typeof rowId === 'object'
        if (fromObject) {
            var opts = rowId
            rowId = opts.id
            stackId = opts.stackId != null ? opts.stackId : opts.id
            scope = opts.scope
            target = opts.target
            party = opts.party
            delta = opts.delta
            activeIf = opts.activeIf
            this.gateWithActiveIf = activeIf != null
        } else if (ELECTORATE_SCOPES[stackId]) {
            // legacy: (stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])
            activeIf = delta
            delta = party
            party = target
            target = scope
            scope = stackId
            stackId = rowId
            this.gateWithActiveIf = arguments.length >= 6 && activeIf != null
        } else {
            this.gateWithActiveIf = arguments.length >= 7 && activeIf != null
        }
        this.id = rowId
        this.stackId = stackId || rowId
        this.scope = scope
        this.target = target || ''
        this.party = party
        this.delta = delta || 0
        this.activeIf = activeIf || function() { return true }
    }

    /** Stack count from Q[stackId]; non-numeric or <= 0 → no effect. */
    stacksFromQ(q) {
        if (!q || q[this.stackId] == null) { return 0 }
        var n = Number(q[this.stackId])
        if (isNaN(n) || n <= 0) { return 0 }
        return n
    }

    isActive(q) {
        try {
            return !!this.activeIf(q)
        } catch (e) {
            return false
        }
    }

    apply(state, q) {
        var stacks = this.stacksFromQ(q)
        if (stacks <= 0) { return }
        if (this.gateWithActiveIf && !this.isActive(q)) { return }
        var shift = this.delta * stacks
        if (this.scope === 'stratum') {
            var dem = state.demographicsById[this.target]
            if (dem) { electorateAddDelta(dem.competitiveScores, this.party, shift) }
        } else if (this.scope === 'district') {
            var dist = state.districtsById[this.target]
            if (dist) { electorateAddDelta(dist.competitiveScores, this.party, shift) }
        } else if (this.scope === 'global') {
            electorateAddDelta(state.global.competitiveScores, this.party, shift)
        }
    }
}

Q.ElectorateModifier = ElectorateModifier

/** How radical the xenophobia is (0–1 linear, then sqrt above 1). Higher → harder for Dems to claw back. */
function effectiveParochialRadicalism(rad) {
    if (isNaN(rad) || rad <= 0) { return 0 }
    if (rad <= 1) { return rad }
    return Math.sqrt(rad)
}

/** Share of derived xenophobia Dems can claw off H (1 − radicalism, floored at 0). */
function demClawBackFraction(rad) {
    return Math.max(0, 1 - effectiveParochialRadicalism(rad))
}

/**
 * Derive modifier stacks from Q.parochialism (0–100).
 * xenophobia_derived: ramps above Suspicion (41+). H+/C− on 1st/2nd via catalog.
 * xenophobia_clawed_back: derived * demClawBackFraction(rad); C still hit by derived only.
 */
Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks = function(q) {
    q = q || Q
    var p = Number(q.parochialism)
    if (isNaN(p)) { p = 0 }
    var rad = Number(q.parochial_radicalism)
    if (isNaN(rad)) { rad = 0.65 }
    var clawMult = demClawBackFraction(rad)

    var suspicionFloor = 41
    var maxStack = 20
    var raw = p <= suspicionFloor ? 0 : ((p - suspicionFloor) / (100 - suspicionFloor)) * maxStack

    q.xenophobia_derived = raw
    q.xenophobia_clawed_back = raw * clawMult
}

/** Opening syndicate prosperity sum (Families + Edges + Sharks @ 8 each). */
var SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE = 24
/** Sum if each syndicate prosperity hits clamp max (20). */
var SYNDICATE_WEALTH_MAX = 60

/**
 * Combined syndicate prosperity → drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe stack (citywide drone stratum).
 * Cheap abstention buys: G up, effective C down. Separate from crime/LE balance.
 * FUTURE: per-syndicate prosperity → separate puppet-party rows in catalog.
 */
Q.syncSyndicateDroneWealthStacks = function(q) {
    q = q || Q
    var f = Number(q.prosperity_families)
    var e = Number(q.prosperity_edges)
    var s = Number(q.prosperity_sharks)
    if (isNaN(f)) { f = 8 }
    if (isNaN(e)) { e = 8 }
    if (isNaN(s)) { s = 8 }
    var combined = f + e + s
    q.syndicate_combined_wealth = combined
    var span = SYNDICATE_WEALTH_MAX - SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE
    var raw = combined <= SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE
        ? 0
        : ((combined - SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE) / span) * 10
    q.drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe = raw
}

Q.applyElectorateModifiers = function() {
    var state = Q.electionV2
    if (!state) { return }

    Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks(Q)
    Q.syncSyndicateDroneWealthStacks(Q)

    state.demographicsById = state.demographicsById || Object.fromEntries(
        state.demographics.map(function(d) { return [d.id, d] })
    )
    state.districtsById = state.districtsById || Object.fromEntries(
        state.districts.map(function(d) { return [d.id, d] })
    )

    // Districts are not rebuilt by syncAllVoteAppeals; reset from baseline each poll.
    for (var j = 0; j < state.districts.length; j++) {
        var dist = state.districts[j]
        dist.competitiveScores = electorateCopyScores(
            dist._baseCompetitiveScores || dist.competitiveScores
        )
    }
    // Strata/global already base+appeals from election runtime sync; add stack deltas only.

    for (var m = 0; m < Q.electorateModifierCatalog.length; m++) {
        Q.electorateModifierCatalog[m].apply(state, Q)
    }
}

// Scopes: stratum (demographic), district (region), global.

var ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS = ['D', 'I', 'C', 'G', 'H']

function electorateZeroScores() {
    return { D: 0, I: 0, C: 0, G: 0, H: 0 }
}

function electorateCopyScores(src) {
    var out = electorateZeroScores()
    for (var i = 0; i < ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS.length; i++) {
        var k = ELECTORATE_PARTY_KEYS[i]
        out[k] = (src && src[k]) || 0
    }
    return out
}

function electorateAddDelta(scores, party, delta) {
    if (scores && scores[party] !== undefined) {
        scores[party] += delta
    }
}

var ELECTORATE_SCOPES = { stratum: 1, district: 1, global: 1 }

class ElectorateModifier {
    /**
     * Positional (table-friendly):
     *   new ElectorateModifier(rowId, stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])
     *   new ElectorateModifier(stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])  // legacy: rowId = stackId
     * stackId: Q quality for stacks (favor_second_wave_housing_dispute += 1).
     * scope: 'stratum' | 'district' | 'global' — use '' for target when global.
     * Object form: { id, stackId?, scope, target, party, delta, activeIf? }
     */
    constructor(rowId, stackId, scope, target, party, delta, activeIf) {
        var fromObject = rowId && typeof rowId === 'object'
        if (fromObject) {
            var opts = rowId
            rowId = opts.id
            stackId = opts.stackId != null ? opts.stackId : opts.id
            scope = opts.scope
            target = opts.target
            party = opts.party
            delta = opts.delta
            activeIf = opts.activeIf
            this.gateWithActiveIf = activeIf != null
        } else if (ELECTORATE_SCOPES[stackId]) {
            // legacy: (stackId, scope, target, party, delta [, activeIf])
            activeIf = delta
            delta = party
            party = target
            target = scope
            scope = stackId
            stackId = rowId
            this.gateWithActiveIf = arguments.length >= 6 && activeIf != null
        } else {
            this.gateWithActiveIf = arguments.length >= 7 && activeIf != null
        }
        this.id = rowId
        this.stackId = stackId || rowId
        this.scope = scope
        this.target = target || ''
        this.party = party
        this.delta = delta || 0
        this.activeIf = activeIf || function() { return true }
    }

    /** Stack count from Q[stackId]; non-numeric or <= 0 → no effect. */
    stacksFromQ(q) {
        if (!q || q[this.stackId] == null) { return 0 }
        var n = Number(q[this.stackId])
        if (isNaN(n) || n <= 0) { return 0 }
        return n
    }

    isActive(q) {
        try {
            return !!this.activeIf(q)
        } catch (e) {
            return false
        }
    }

    apply(state, q) {
        var stacks = this.stacksFromQ(q)
        if (stacks <= 0) { return }
        if (this.gateWithActiveIf && !this.isActive(q)) { return }
        var shift = this.delta * stacks
        if (this.scope === 'stratum') {

        } else if (this.scope === 'global') {
            electorateAddDelta(state.global.competitiveScores, this.party, shift)
        }
    }

/** How radical the xenophobia is (0–1 linear, then sqrt above 1). Higher → harder for Dems to claw back. */
function effectiveParochialRadicalism(rad) {
    if (isNaN(rad) || rad <= 0) { return 0 }
    if (rad <= 1) { return rad }
    return Math.sqrt(rad)
}

/** Share of derived xenophobia Dems can claw off H (1 − radicalism, floored at 0). */
function demClawBackFraction(rad) {
    return Math.max(0, 1 - effectiveParochialRadicalism(rad))
}

/**
 * Derive modifier stacks from Q.parochialism (0–100).
 * xenophobia_derived: ramps above Suspicion (41+). H+/C− on 1st/2nd via catalog.
 * xenophobia_clawed_back: derived * demClawBackFraction(rad); C still hit by derived only.
 */
Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks = function(q) {
    q = q || Q
    var p = Number(q.parochialism)
    if (isNaN(p)) { p = 0 }
    var rad = Number(q.parochial_radicalism)
    if (isNaN(rad)) { rad = 0.65 }
    var clawMult = demClawBackFraction(rad)

    var suspicionFloor = 41
    var maxStack = 20
    var raw = p <= suspicionFloor ? 0 : ((p - suspicionFloor) / (100 - suspicionFloor)) * maxStack

    q.xenophobia_derived = raw
    q.xenophobia_clawed_back = raw * clawMult
}

/** Opening syndicate prosperity sum (Families + Edges + Sharks @ 8 each). */
var SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE = 24
/** Sum if each syndicate prosperity hits clamp max (20). */
var SYNDICATE_WEALTH_MAX = 60

/**
 * Combined syndicate prosperity → drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe stack (citywide drone stratum).
 * Cheap abstention buys: G up, effective C down. Separate from crime/LE balance.
 * FUTURE: per-syndicate prosperity → separate puppet-party rows in catalog.
 */
Q.syncSyndicateDroneWealthStacks = function(q) {
    q = q || Q
    var f = Number(q.prosperity_families)
    var e = Number(q.prosperity_edges)
    var s = Number(q.prosperity_sharks)
    if (isNaN(f)) { f = 8 }
    if (isNaN(e)) { e = 8 }
    if (isNaN(s)) { s = 8 }
    var combined = f + e + s
    q.syndicate_combined_wealth = combined
    var span = SYNDICATE_WEALTH_MAX - SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE
    var raw = combined <= SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE
        ? 0
        : ((combined - SYNDICATE_WEALTH_BASELINE) / span) * 10
    q.drone_syndicate_wealth_bribe = raw
}

Q.applyElectorateModifiers = function() {
    var state = Q.electionV2
    if (!state) { return }

    Q.syncParochialismXenophobiaStacks(Q)
    Q.syncSyndicateDroneWealthStacks(Q)

    state.demographicsById = state.demographicsById || Object.fromEntries(
        state.demographics.map(function(d) { return [d.id, d] })
    )
    state.districtsById = state.districtsById || Object.fromEntries(
        state.districts.map(function(d) { return [d.id, d] })
    )

    // Districts are not rebuilt by syncAllVoteAppeals; reset from baseline each poll.
    for (var j = 0; j < state.districts.length; j++) {
        var dist = state.districts[j]
        dist.competitiveScores = electorateCopyScores(
            dist._baseCompetitiveScores || dist.competitiveScores
        )
    }
    // Strata/global already base+appeals from election runtime sync; add stack deltas only.

    for (var m = 0; m < Q.electorateModifierCatalog.length; m++) {
        Q.electorateModifierCatalog[m].apply(state, Q)
    }
}
// MIKASA_ELECTORATE_RUNTIME_END

| numbers | `0.15 + 0.12×Q.militia + 0.08×Q.militia_police` (same all districts) |

Synced onto every district militia row each `ensureDistrictParamilitary()` / monthly tick.

Institutional footprint only — **not** monthly rank growth from beating LE. Matches IG home districts in [`prosperity_connection_catalog.md`](../cards/local_organizing/prosperity_connection_catalog.md).

| IG | District | Q | N | M | L |
|----|----------|---|---|---|---|
| Families | Pitts | 0.42 | 0.38 | 0.52 | 0.72 |
| Edges | Railyard | 0.38 | 0.28 | 0.48 | 0.65 |
| Sharks | Deeps | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.50 | 0.68 |

Not yet merged into `Q.districtParamilitary` or outlaw mass sum.

## 5. Corporate police home (`PARAMILITARY_CORP_POLICE_HOME_DEFAULT`)

Separate from city police row; used for corp asset guard / corp LE when wired.

| IG | District | Q | N | M | L |
|----|----------|---|---|---|---|
| Soylent | Vats | 0.78 | 1.20 | 0.58 | 0.62 |
| Magrail | Railyard | 0.76 | 1.15 | 0.56 | 0.60 |
| Brazos | Limelight | 0.77 | 1.18 | 0.57 | 0.61 |

---

## 6. Watch (`PARAMILITARY_WATCH_DEFAULT`)

Future public LE term: `prosperityCoeff × district prosperity + parochialismCoeff × Q.parochialism`.

| Key | Value |
